newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Oil Search PNG well flows 1,910 bpd.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Oil Search PNG well flows 1,910 bpd.

text.p: Oil Search Ltd said on Wednesday that the Moran 1X well in the central highlands of Papua New Guinea flowed 1,910 barrels of oil per day during a flow test.
Oil Search said the flow was from the interval 2,938 to 2,975 metres and there were indications the flow was restricted due to pressure gauge problems.

The well is five km west of the Paua IX oil discovery well and 11 kilometres north of the Agogo processing facilities which are part of the Kutubu project. Oil Search has a 7.763 percent stake in the well while the operator, Chevron Corp unit Chevron Niugini Pty Ltd, has 19.375 percent.

"Interpretation of the test data indicates good reservoir properties and production well performance will be substantially higher than the operationally limited rate observed on this test," Oil Search said. The well also flowed gas at the rate of 4.089 million cubic feet per day.

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd unit BHP Petroleum (PNG) Inc has a 9.688 percent holding, BP Australia Ltd has 19.375 percent, Mobil Corp unit Ampolex Ltd has 16.455 percent, JPP has 4.844 percent, and Petroleum Resources Kutubu Pty Ltd has 22.50 percent.
